description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); One(ID LONG primary key) with one row. Table U(ID LONG primary key, c TEXT(1)) with the units [a A b B c C z Z 0 9 [ \ ^ _ ` { ä Ä á Á à À æ Æ ß ÿ Ÿ × ÷ ø Ø Ā ā ı ж Ж α ½] as IDs 1 to 38 and ID 39 with c Null. For each pattern [[a-c] ;; [A-C] ;; [!a-c] ;; [Z-a] ;; [z-à] ;; [à-æ] ;; [À-Æ] ;; [ß-ÿ] ;; [×-÷] ;; [ж] ;; [Ж] ;; [Ā-ā] ;; [a-ä] ;; [ä] ;; ä ;; Ä ;; [a-z] ;; [!a-z] ;; [0-9] ;; [_-a]]: SELECT ID FROM U WHERE c LIKE pattern ORDER BY ID, every ID read. Then c NOT LIKE '*', c NOT LIKE 'a', NOT (c LIKE '*'), c LIKE Null, c NOT LIKE Null, c LIKE '*' OR c IS NULL. Separates code-unit order, case-folded code-unit order and collation order for class ranges, and the Null rule of NOT LIKE.
